analogy.rationale: L-type calcium channels (CACNA1C/D) are the canonical targets, but these cell lines are non-excitable and express low levels of voltage-gated calcium channels, so transcriptional responses should be weak; T-type blockers share the calcium channel mechanism most closely, while other ion-channel blockers and local anesthetics overlap in electrophysiological but not transcriptional effects.
